target_pattern: Use imperative forms by addressee and polarity, and place object pronouns correctly: attached in affirmative commands and before the verb in negative commands.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Using modal or future-style statements instead of direct imperative forms.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish marks commands with dedicated verb forms and shifts pronoun position depending on affirmative or negative polarity.
target_pattern_formula: tu affirmative: present el/ella form or irregular haz, di, ve, pon, sal, se, ten, ven
tu negative: no plus present subjunctive
usted and ustedes commands: present subjunctive forms
nosotros command: subjunctive for both affirmative and negative
affirmative pronouns attach, negative pronouns go before the verb
RID order: reflexive then indirect then direct

controlled_recombination.instructions: Write each in Spanish using the correct command form.
prompts_en: Put the keys on the table. (tu)
Do not leave without your coat. (tu)
Come with me to the store. (tu)
Let us take a break now. (nosotros)
Do not sit in that broken chair. (tu)
Let us eat at that restaurant tonight. (nosotros)
Do not leave the meeting yet. (ustedes, irse)
Give it to me now. (tu, libro)
Bring it to me before class. (usted, reporte)
Do not explain it to me again. (usted, regla)
Let us tell it to them tomorrow. (nosotros, historia)
Do not write it for me. (tu, carta)

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Pon la mesa. -> change to negative tu.
Base: Hazlo ahora. -> change to usted affirmative.
Base: No salgas tarde. -> change to affirmative tu.
Base: Espere aqui. -> change to ustedes affirmative.
Base: Apaguen los telefonos. -> change to negative ustedes.
Base: Comamos aqui. -> change to negative nosotros.
Base: No te sientes ahi. -> change to affirmative tu reflexive.
Base: Digamos la verdad. -> change to usted affirmative.
Base: Firme este documento. -> change to negative usted.
Base: Dime la verdad. -> rewrite with direct and indirect pronouns, it to me.
Base: No me lo digas. -> change to affirmative tu.
Base: Traigamelo. -> change to negative usted.
Base: No se vayan todavia. -> change to affirmative ustedes.
Base: Tengamos paciencia. -> change to tu affirmative.
Base: No lo escribas. -> change to nosotros negative.

Using affirmative reflexive shape in negative command.
